nodes.label: Initiate Retail Activation Journey
nodes.desc: Retail Agent initiates a New Postpaid Mobility activation journey for a walk-in customer from the Agent Desktop.

nodes.label: Authenticate Agent & Check Role
nodes.desc: System authenticates the Retail Agent and authorizes journey access based on the agent role defined in the Agent Role Privilege Matrix (TBD).

nodes.label: Journey Access Denied
nodes.desc: An agent without the New Activation privilege is denied journey initiation and an authorisation message is displayed.

nodes.label: Create Q Ticket in Qnomy
nodes.desc: System creates a Q Ticket in Qnomy for the service type selected by the customer at the queue kiosk.

nodes.label: Select Next Q Ticket
nodes.desc: Retail Agent selects the next available Q Ticket from the Qnomy queue; the corresponding service journey opens with the ticket reference bound to the session.

nodes.label: Qnomy Unavailable Fallback
nodes.desc: Where Qnomy is unavailable the journey proceeds without a Q Ticket reference; the reference is recorded as Not Available.

nodes.label: Auto-create Tracking Record
nodes.desc: System automatically creates a Tracking Record on journey initiation, assigned to the initiating Retail Agent, in New status.

nodes.label: Tracking Record Mandatory Fields
nodes.desc: Configured mandatory fields must be populated automatically on the Tracking Record at creation; creation is rejected otherwise.

nodes.label: Persist Journey Milestone (Draft Order)
nodes.desc: System persists the journey milestone as a Draft Order on each successful stage validation so the journey can be resumed without re-keying captured data.

nodes.label: View & Resume Draft Orders
nodes.desc: Retail Agent can view and resume the list of Draft Orders that agent initiated.

nodes.label: Expire Draft Order
nodes.desc: A Draft Order not submitted within the configured retention period is expired and all held reservations (MSISDN, SIM) are released.

nodes.label: Scan Identity Document
nodes.desc: Retail Agent scans the customer identity document through IDWise: front page, back page, and optional liveliness (selfie) check where the customer consents.

nodes.label: Validate Permitted ID Type
nodes.desc: System accepts only QID, Passport, Diplomatic ID and GCC ID; any other document type is rejected with a validation message.

nodes.label: Unsupported Document Type Rejected
nodes.desc: Scanning an unsupported document type returns a rejection message and the journey does not advance.

nodes.label: Capture Special ID (MADA)
nodes.desc: System optionally accepts a MADA ID to be considered for special discount.

nodes.label: Re-scan on Capture Failure
nodes.desc: Retail Agent may re-scan the identity document where IDWise fails to extract information on a previous attempt.

nodes.label: Manual ID Capture Fallback
nodes.desc: Where IDWise is unavailable or fails after the configured maximum scan attempts, the agent captures identity details manually; capture source is recorded as Manual.

nodes.label: Capture ID Attributes
nodes.desc: System captures ID Type, ID Number, First Name, Last Name, Date of Birth, Nationality and ID Expiry Date from the scanned document.

nodes.label: Display Scanned ID to Agent
nodes.desc: Extracted identity information is displayed to the Retail Agent for visual confirmation against the physical document.

nodes.label: Age Verification
nodes.desc: System executes age verification from the Date of Birth field and rejects if the customer age is below 18 years.

nodes.label: Journey Aborted (Under 18)
nodes.desc: Journey is aborted if customer age is below 18 years.

nodes.label: MOI Lookup
nodes.desc: System retrieves customer information from MOI using QID, Diplomatic ID or Passport Number for any issuing country.

nodes.label: GCC ID Excluded from MOI
nodes.desc: MOI validation is not invoked for a GCC ID because MOI validation is not supported for that document type.

nodes.label: Compare IDWise vs MOI Fields
nodes.desc: System compares First Name, Last Name, ID Number, Date of Birth and Nationality between the IDWise capture and the MOI response.

nodes.label: Full Match Check
nodes.desc: Retail Agent may proceed only where all five compared attributes match exactly.

nodes.label: Mismatch Handling
nodes.desc: On mismatch the agent is offered Reject and Re-scan actions.

nodes.label: Display MOI Attributes
nodes.desc: System displays ID Type, ID Number, Date of Birth, name fields, Nationality, Salutation and ID Expiry Date returned by MOI on the customer verification screen.

nodes.label: MOI ID Status Check
nodes.desc: System retrieves ID Status from MOI and permits journey types by ID status: Active QID permits New Connection; Expired QID permits Modification only; expired Passport/GCC ID/Diplomatic ID permits neither.

nodes.label: ID Status Blocks Journey
nodes.desc: Expired ID status not permitted for New Connection blocks journey progression.

nodes.label: Record MOI Validation Timestamp
nodes.desc: System records the MOI validation timestamp against the customer record on every successful validation.

nodes.label: MOI Unavailable Fallback
nodes.desc: Where MOI is unavailable the order is saved as a draft; MOI validation is enforced as a mandatory gate at order submission.

nodes.label: Transfer Scanned ID to CRM
nodes.desc: Extracted identity information is transferred from IDWise to CRM for customer creation and validation, at the First Milestone.

nodes.label: ID Expiry Date Source of Truth
nodes.desc: ID Expiry Date in CRM is populated from the IDWise scan because MOI does not return an expiry date.

nodes.label: Interim Expiry Date Derivation
nodes.desc: System captures ID Expiry Date from MOI even if IDWise returns the data; MOI data supersedes any scanned data.

nodes.label: Customer Representative Restriction
nodes.desc: A Postpaid or Prepaid connection may not be taken by a representative acting on behalf of the customer; no representative path is available.

nodes.label: Existing Customer Check
nodes.desc: System determines whether the customer already exists by matching ID Type, ID Number and Nationality against existing customer records.

nodes.label: Display Existing Customer
nodes.desc: Retrieved customer information is displayed to the Retail Agent for confirmation before the journey continues.

nodes.label: Create New Customer Record
nodes.desc: System creates a new customer record carrying the captured identity attributes where the matching combination does not correspond to any existing record.

nodes.label: Overwrite Existing Attributes from MOI
nodes.desc: Any attribute on an existing customer record is overwritten from the latest MOI response following successful MOI validation.

nodes.label: Existing Contact Identification
nodes.desc: System identifies an existing contact using ID Type and ID Number before creating a new contact; a matching contact is reused rather than duplicated.

nodes.label: Lock Verified Attributes
nodes.desc: ID Number, ID Type, name fields, Date of Birth, Nationality, ID Expiry Date and Salutation are rendered non-editable following successful MOI validation.

nodes.label: Capture Editable Address
nodes.desc: Address returned by MOI (Building Number, Street Number, Zone, Apartment/Villa/Flat Number) is presented as editable and can be amended by the agent.

nodes.label: Mandatory Account Attributes
nodes.desc: Account Type, Customer Category and Segment must be populated before the customer account can be created; creation is blocked until then.

nodes.label: Derive Category & Segment
nodes.desc: Customer Category and Segment are derived automatically from customer Nationality using the configured nationality-to-customer-type matrix.

nodes.label: Create Default Primary Contact
nodes.desc: A default primary contact is created for the customer account using the verified customer identity information.

nodes.label: Populate Default Credit Limit
nodes.desc: Default credit limit on the customer account is populated based on the customer segment, per the parameter table in Business Rules.

nodes.label: Agent-overridable Attributes
nodes.desc: Retail Agent may override Email Address, Language and Alternate Phone Number on the customer account.

nodes.label: Derive HRN Nationality Flag
nodes.desc: High Risk Nationality flag is derived from the customer nationality returned by MOI using the HRN nationality list held in the custom table.

nodes.label: Display HRN Advance Payment Message
nodes.desc: Configured advance payment message is displayed on the customer creation page where the customer is flagged as High Risk Nationality.

nodes.label: Allow Multiple Contacts
nodes.desc: Multiple contacts may be associated with a single customer account.

nodes.label: Assign Contact Role
nodes.desc: A role can be assigned to each contact created against the customer account, identifying the relation (e.g. personal account or SPOC for enterprise).

nodes.label: Capture & Verify Email
nodes.desc: Retail Agent captures the customer Email Address and verifies it through the email verification service, marking the address Verified on success.

nodes.label: Email Verification Restricted to Retail
nodes.desc: Use of the email verification service is restricted to the Retail channel.

nodes.label: Milestone 1: Customer Contact Created & Product Offer Eligibility Captured
nodes.desc: First Milestone: customer contact created and product offer eligibility captured.

nodes.label: Connection Type Eligibility by ID Type
nodes.desc: Eligibility for Postpaid and Prepaid connection types is determined by customer ID type: QID and Diplomatic ID permit Postpaid; Passport and GCC ID are restricted to Prepaid.

nodes.label: Minimum Age Validation
nodes.desc: Customer age is calculated from Date of Birth; journey is blocked where the customer is under eighteen.

nodes.label: Eligibility Failure Messaging
nodes.desc: A distinct validation message is displayed on the UI for each eligibility failure condition so the agent can communicate the reason to the customer.

nodes.label: Blacklist Check
nodes.desc: Journey progression is blocked where the customer status is returned as Blacklisted (from EDW or third-party service).

nodes.label: In-Collections Check
nodes.desc: Journey progression is blocked where the customer status is returned as In Collections.

nodes.label: Outstanding Dues Threshold
nodes.desc: Customer outstanding balance is retrieved; progression is blocked where the balance exceeds the configured threshold.

nodes.label: Settle Dues & Re-check
nodes.desc: Retail Agent directs the customer to settle outstanding dues; balance is re-evaluated before permitting the journey to continue.

nodes.label: Retrieve Active Line Count
nodes.desc: System retrieves the total number of active mobile voice connections associated with the customer.

nodes.label: Qatari National Line Count Exemption
nodes.desc: No line count restriction is applied where the customer nationality is Qatari, Safwa, or Safwa Plus.

nodes.label: Expatriate Line Count Ceiling
nodes.desc: A QID-holding expatriate customer may hold up to five mobile voice connections, all of which may be Postpaid; a sixth is not permitted.

nodes.label: Line Count Breach & Approval Task
nodes.desc: Validation message displayed on breach; agent may proceed subject to approval task. Credit team approval task is created for 3rd-5th Postpaid connection for an expatriate.

nodes.label: Order Held Pending Approval
nodes.desc: Retail Agent captures and holds the order; submission is permitted only once the associated approval task has been approved.

nodes.label: Order Cancelled on Rejection
nodes.desc: Retail Agent may cancel the held order where the associated approval task is rejected; all reservations are released.

nodes.label: Credit Limit Not Amendable at Activation
nodes.desc: Credit limit enhancement is not permitted within the New Activation journey; the capability applies only to Modification and Add-On journeys.

nodes.label: Credit Limit Amendment Authority
nodes.desc: An agent may amend the system-defaulted credit limit only within the range permitted for the customer segment, and only where the agent holds the privileged role (not during Activation).

nodes.label: Credit Limit Escalation to Collections
nodes.desc: A credit limit increase beyond the agent-permitted value is routed to the Collections team as an approval ticket; the limit is not applied until approved.

nodes.label: Collect Advance Payment (Credit Delta)
nodes.desc: System collects the delta amount between the default and the enhanced credit limit as a refundable deposit before the order is saved.

nodes.label: Advance Payment Utilisation
nodes.desc: Advance payment is adjusted against the next bill cycle.

nodes.label: Issue Credit Note on Cancellation
nodes.desc: A credit note adjustment is created and issued to the customer where an order carrying a collected payment is cancelled.

nodes.label: Create Billing Account
nodes.desc: Retail Agent creates a billing account for a new customer account, capturing the attributes defined for billing accounts.

nodes.label: Select Existing Billing Account
nodes.desc: Retail Agent may select an existing billing account in the cart during a plan purchase, where one or more already exist against the customer.

nodes.label: Single Billing Account per Plan
nodes.desc: Exactly one billing account is associated with a plan; multiple connections/plans in the same cart can each be associated with a specific billing account.

nodes.label: Select Billing Address
nodes.desc: Retail Agent adopts the customer address as the billing address or captures a new billing address.

nodes.label: Multiple Billing Contacts
nodes.desc: A billing account may carry multiple billing contacts, of which exactly one is designated primary and the remainder secondary.

nodes.label: Invoice Delivery to Primary Contact
nodes.desc: The bill invoice is delivered to the primary billing contact of the billing account.

nodes.label: Active Payment Profile Mandatory
nodes.desc: Only a billing account holding an active payment profile may be selected for an activation order.

nodes.label: Multiple Payment Profiles Allowed
nodes.desc: A billing account may hold multiple payment profiles.

nodes.label: Add Billing Account at Cart Validation
nodes.desc: Retail Agent may add a billing account holding an active payment profile at the cart validation stage where none is present.

nodes.label: Bill Cycle Default for VIP
nodes.desc: Bill cycle defaults to "Black" (7th of month) where the customer segment is VIP.

nodes.label: Bill Cycle Default by Submission Date
nodes.desc: For a non-VIP customer, bill cycle defaults to the 1st or 15th of the month, selecting the next cycle where the order submission date falls within three days of the cycle date.

nodes.label: Capture Payment Profile
nodes.desc: Retail Agent captures Payment Method, Payment Type and Billing Frequency; only credit card and debit card are allowed for auto-debit.

nodes.label: Validate Payment Profile
nodes.desc: Captured payment details are validated and the payment profile is updated only following successful validation, capturing last 4 digits of card and the token number.

nodes.label: Recapture Payment on Failure
nodes.desc: Retail Agent is returned to the payment profile capture screen where payment validation fails, to recapture the details.

nodes.label: Milestone 2: Customer Bill Profile Created
nodes.desc: Second Milestone: customer bill profile created (Postpaid only).

nodes.label: Present Eligible Base Plans
nodes.desc: Only base plans for which the customer is eligible (by segment and connection type) are presented.

nodes.label: Add-on Eligibility
nodes.desc: Only add-ons eligible for the selected base plan are presented; selection of an ineligible add-on is prevented.

nodes.label: Add-on Cardinality
nodes.desc: Configured add-on cardinality rules (minimum, maximum, default quantity) are enforced.

nodes.label: Discount Eligibility
nodes.desc: Only discounts eligible for the selected base plan are presented; selection of an ineligible discount is prevented.

nodes.label: Create Cart
nodes.desc: Retail Agent creates a cart containing the selected base plan, add-ons and discounts; an order number is allocated.

nodes.label: Amend Cart Before Submission
nodes.desc: Retail Agent may review, amend and remove selected plans, add-ons and discounts at any point before order submission.

nodes.label: Recalculate Cart Price
nodes.desc: One-time charges, recurring charges and discounts are recalculated whenever a product is added, amended or removed.

nodes.label: Apply Latest Discount Version
nodes.desc: The latest effective version of an eligible discount is applied to the cart.

nodes.label: Display Bill Limit
nodes.desc: The bill limit associated with the selected base plan is displayed on the cart.

nodes.label: Special Discount Documentation
nodes.desc: MADA identity document upload is required as a supporting document where a special discount is added to the cart (captured during KYC).

nodes.label: Retrieve Reserved Number
nodes.desc: System determines whether an active reserved MSISDN exists for the customer (from telesales or any other channel), using the customer QID.

nodes.label: Auto-populate Reserved Number
nodes.desc: An existing active reserved MSISDN is auto-populated (pre-selected) on the number selection screen where found.

nodes.label: Number Category Display Order
nodes.desc: Number categories are displayed in the sequence Reserved Number, then Star Number, then Free Number.

nodes.label: Reserved Number Price Validation
nodes.desc: The price of the reserved MSISDN is validated against the price entitlement of the selected base plan.

nodes.label: Upfront Charge for Premium Number
nodes.desc: Applicable price and upfront charge are displayed where the reserved MSISDN price exceeds the base plan entitlement.

nodes.label: Reserve MSISDN on Confirmation
nodes.desc: Selected MSISDN is reserved on confirmation, preventing allocation through any other order or channel.

nodes.label: Release Reservation After 72 Hours
nodes.desc: A reserved MSISDN not consumed by the same customer within seventy-two hours of reservation is released back to the available pool.

nodes.label: Search & Select Star Number
nodes.desc: Retail Agent searches the Star Number list and selects a preferred MSISDN into the cart.

nodes.label: Star Number Eligibility by Plan Price
nodes.desc: Only Star Numbers whose price falls within the entitlement band of the selected base plan price are displayed.

nodes.label: Star Number Display Order
nodes.desc: Eligible Star Numbers are displayed in descending order of price.

nodes.label: Display Star Number Charges
nodes.desc: Number category, applicable price and upfront charge are displayed for a Star Number before the agent confirms selection.

nodes.label: Star Number Lock-in Period
nodes.desc: Lock-in period applicable to the selected Star Number is displayed to the agent.

nodes.label: Search & Select Free Number
nodes.desc: Retail Agent searches the Free Number list and selects a preferred MSISDN into the cart.

nodes.label: Select SIM Type
nodes.desc: Retail Agent selects a SIM type from Physical SIM, eSIM and Virtual eSIM; the selection is carried into the cart.

nodes.label: Scan Physical SIM / Printed eSIM
nodes.desc: Retail Agent scans and assigns a Physical SIM or Printed eSIM to the order; the scanned serial number resolves to a SIM record.

nodes.label: Generate Virtual eSIM
nodes.desc: Retail Agent generates a Virtual eSIM and assigns it to the order; an ICCID is allocated.

nodes.label: Validate SIM Identifier
nodes.desc: Scanned SIM identifier is validated against inventory; SIM Type, SIM Serial Number and ICCID are captured.

nodes.label: Add SIM as Order Line Item
nodes.desc: Allocated SIM is added to the order as a line item and reserved in inventory until order completion.

nodes.label: Deliver Virtual eSIM by Email
nodes.desc: Virtual eSIM profile is delivered to the customer by email where the eSIM option is selected.

nodes.label: SIM Swap Reason Out of Scope
nodes.desc: SIM Swap Reason is captured in a separate SIM Swap journey and is not applicable to the New Postpaid Activation journey.

nodes.label: Pre-payment Validation Gate
nodes.desc: All customer, account, billing, number, SIM, product, eligibility and compatibility validations execute before payment is initiated.

nodes.label: Block Progression on Validation Failure
nodes.desc: Order progression is prevented until every mandatory validation has completed successfully; failing validations are listed to the agent.

nodes.label: Review Cart Before Payment
nodes.desc: Retail Agent reviews plan, SIM, MSISDN, service components and price before proceeding to CAF generation and payment collection.

nodes.label: Collect Star Number Upfront Charge
nodes.desc: Additional upfront charge for a Star Number is collected where the number category price exceeds the base plan entitlement.

nodes.label: Collect HRN Advance Payment
nodes.desc: Advance payment applicable to a High Risk Nationality customer is collected as a precondition to eligibility for the selected plan/product.

nodes.label: Collect Credit Limit Increase Advance Payment
nodes.desc: Applicable advance payment for credit limit enhancement is collected upfront.

nodes.label: Adjust Advance Payment on First Bill
nodes.desc: Any advance payment collected is adjusted against the first bill issued to the customer.

nodes.label: Display Payment Summary
nodes.desc: Payment summary and total payable amount are displayed to the Retail Agent before payment is confirmed.

nodes.label: Milestone 3: Cart Checked Out
nodes.desc: Third Milestone: cart checked out.

nodes.label: Display Key Information (T&Cs)
nodes.desc: Key terms and conditions are displayed before CAF submission: selected plan, plan lock-in, Star Number, Star Number lock-in, device on instalment and its lock-in; displayed only at Retail Agent outlet.

nodes.label: Vary Key Information by Context
nodes.desc: Terms and conditions presented vary according to the service type.

nodes.label: Refresh Key Information on Cart Change
nodes.desc: Key information is refreshed whenever the cart is amended, so key information and the final cart stay consistent at CAF submission.

nodes.label: Generate CAF from Template
nodes.desc: Digital CAF is generated from the pre-configured template selected on the basis of product type and service type.

nodes.label: CAF Template Selection Matrix
nodes.desc: CAF template is selected using the configured matrix of agent role, channel and service type.

nodes.label: Populate CAF from Customer & Cart
nodes.desc: CAF is populated with customer information from the customer details section and service details from the cart section.

nodes.label: Select Signature Option
nodes.desc: Retail Agent selects between an offline signed paper CAF or an online signed digital CAF.

nodes.label: Upload Offline Signed CAF
nodes.desc: Retail Agent uploads a manually signed paper CAF; it is attached to the order.

nodes.label: CAF File Format & Size Check
nodes.desc: CAF upload is accepted in PDF or JPG format only, up to two megabytes per document; oversized/unsupported files are rejected.

nodes.label: Select Signature Capture Device
nodes.desc: Retail Agent selects signature capture method: CAF Digital (customer-facing touchpad) or CAF Touch Screen (touch screen laptop).

nodes.label: Display CAF to Customer
nodes.desc: CAF content is displayed to the customer on the selected capture device for review before signature.

nodes.label: Capture & Display Signature
nodes.desc: Customer signature is captured at the counter and displayed within the online CAF on the agent UI.

nodes.label: Upload Supporting Documents
nodes.desc: Retail Agent attaches supporting documents required for activation, in PDF or JPG format up to two megabytes per document.

nodes.label: View & Download Uploaded Documents
nodes.desc: Uploaded documents are displayed in a dedicated UI section and can be viewed and downloaded by the Retail Agent.

nodes.label: Milestone 4: Signed CAF
nodes.desc: Fourth Milestone: signed CAF.

nodes.label: Send Payment Request to WinCash
nodes.desc: Upfront payment request is sent to WinCash; CRM payment status is updated from the WinCash response.

nodes.label: Payment Failure Hold
nodes.desc: Order is placed on hold and the Retail Agent is returned to the payment summary screen for a further attempt where payment fails.

nodes.label: Failed Payment Attempt Limit
nodes.desc: Number of failed payment attempts is recorded against the order; further attempts are blocked once the configured maximum is reached.

nodes.label: Issue Receipt
nodes.desc: Customer is provided the receipt generated by WinCash, including where the payable amount is zero.

nodes.label: Post Bill Payment
nodes.desc: Captured bill payments are posted to the billing system.

nodes.label: Deplete Physical SIM Inventory
nodes.desc: Physical SIM or Printed eSIM is depleted from stock through WinCash on payment completion.

nodes.label: Defer Virtual eSIM Depletion
nodes.desc: Virtual eSIM is not allocated to store and its inventory is not maintained at WinCash; depletion happens at order fulfilment stage, marked consumed within UIM.

nodes.label: Submit Order
nodes.desc: Retail Agent submits the order once payment has completed successfully; submit is enabled only where payment status is Paid.

nodes.label: Milestone 4: Order Submitted
nodes.desc: Final Milestone: order submitted.

nodes.label: Route Order to Fulfilment
nodes.desc: Order is submitted to the downstream provisioning and activation systems following successful payment.

nodes.label: Navigate to Customer 360 Order List
nodes.desc: Retail Agent is navigated to the Customer 360 All Orders view once the order has been submitted to downstream systems.

nodes.label: View Order Detail
nodes.desc: Retail Agent may open any order from the All Orders view to see the order detail.

nodes.label: Receive Order Completion
nodes.desc: Order completion notification is received from downstream systems into CRM once provisioning and activation have completed.

nodes.label: Handle Order Failure
nodes.desc: Order is set to failed state on receipt of a downstream failure; the failure reason is made available to the agent.

nodes.label: Communicate Activation Service Level
nodes.desc: Four business-hour Postpaid activation service level is displayed to the Retail Agent for communication to the customer.

nodes.label: Resolve Tracking Record
nodes.desc: Tracking Record status is set to Resolved once the order status is completed in CRM; the order number is recorded on the record.

nodes.label: Mandatory Fields on Resolution
nodes.desc: Configured mandatory fields must be populated before the Tracking Record can be set to Resolved.

nodes.label: Send Order Submission Notification
nodes.desc: Order submission notification is sent to the customer through the mode selected on the customer record (email or SMS).

nodes.label: Send Order Failure Notification
nodes.desc: Order failure notification is sent to the customer where the order fails within downstream systems.

nodes.label: Send Order Completion Notification
nodes.desc: Order completion acknowledgement is sent to the customer through the mode selected on the customer record.

nodes.label: Notify All MSISDNs on QID
nodes.desc: Activation notification is sent to every active MSISDN registered against the customer QID, per CRA requirement.

nodes.label: Notification Template Configurability
nodes.desc: Notification trigger point, template and recipient list are sourced from configuration so templates can be amended without a code change.

nodes.label: Trigger Feedback Survey
nodes.desc: Customer feedback survey request is sent to the "Customer Survey" system once the Tracking Record is set to Resolved.

nodes.label: Capture Feedback & Close Tracking Record
nodes.desc: Tracking Record is updated to Closed once customer feedback is received from the "Customer Survey" system.

agents.Name: Journey and Session Management
agents.Purpose / Feature: Journey initiation, agent authorisation, Qnomy queue and ticketing, automatic tracking record creation, milestone persistence and draft order resume

agents.Name: Customer Identification and Verification
agents.Purpose / Feature: Identity document scan through IDWise, permitted document types, manual capture fallback, MOI validation and field comparison, identity status check and high risk nationality derivation

agents.Name: Customer and Account Management
agents.Purpose / Feature: Existing customer and contact matching, new customer creation, account attribute derivation, contact model, address capture and email verification, subscriber/child account creation & association with billing account

agents.Name: Eligibility and Credit Control
agents.Purpose / Feature: Connection type and age eligibility, blacklist and collections screening, outstanding dues threshold, active line count control, approval task gating and credit limit authority

agents.Name: Billing Account Management
agents.Purpose / Feature: Billing account creation and selection, billing contact model, payment profile capture and validation, and bill cycle derivation

agents.Name: Product Catalogue and Cart
agents.Purpose / Feature: Base plan, add on and discount eligibility, add on cardinality, cart creation and amendment, price recalculation and special discount evidence

agents.Name: Number Management
agents.Purpose / Feature: Reserved number retrieval and auto population, category display sequence, Star Number entitlement and lock in, premium number charging, reservation lock and release

agents.Name: SIM Management
agents.Purpose / Feature: SIM type selection, physical and printed eSIM scan, Virtual eSIM generation, identifier validation, inventory reservation and eSIM delivery

agents.Name: Cart Validation & Check Out
agents.Purpose / Feature: Pre payment validation gate, eligibility, compatibility & cardinality rule check, payment request summary display

agents.Name: Contract and Documentation
agents.Purpose / Feature: Key information display and refresh, CAF template selection and generation, digital and offline signature capture, and supporting document upload

agents.Name: Payment and Inventory
agents.Purpose / Feature: Payment summary, upfront charge and deposit collection (if any), advance payment adjustment, WinCash request and response handling, receipt issuance and inventory depletion

agents.Name: Order Submission
agents.Purpose / Feature: Order submission and routing to fulfilment, activity capture, Customer 360 order views, completion and failure handling and tracking record lifecycle

agents.Name: Notification and Feedback
agents.Purpose / Feature: Order submission, failure and completion notification, regulatory notification to all MSISDNs on the QID, template configurability and feedback survey despatch

contracts.RuleStatement: Journey access is granted only to an agent holding the New Activation privilege as defined in the agent role model.
Where Qnomy is unavailable the journey proceeds without a Q Ticket reference
A Tracking Record is created at journey initiation and owned by the initiating agent. Mandatory fields are configured
The journey milestone is persisted on every successful stage validation
An agent may view and resume only the Draft Orders that agent created
A Draft Order not submitted within the retention period is expired and its reservations released
Front page and back page are mandatory. Liveliness is optional and subject to customer consent
Only QID, Passport, Diplomatic ID and GCC ID are accepted
Re scan is permitted on extraction failure up to the configured maximum number of attempts
Manual capture is permitted where IDWise fails or is unavailable and the capture source is recorded
ID Expiry Date is sourced from MOI and is overwritten after each MOI validation.
HRN status is derived from nationality using the HRN nationality list held in the Siebel LOV and is passed to WinCash for advance Payment collection
MOI validation applies to QID, Diplomatic ID and Passport. MOI validation is not performed for GCC ID
First Name, Last Name, ID Number and Date of Birth must match exactly between IDWise and MOI for the journey to proceed
An active QID, Passport, GCC ID or Diplomatic ID permits New Connection and Modification. An expired QID permits Modification only. An expired Passport, GCC ID or Diplomatic ID permits no action
Where MOI is unavailable the order is drafted and MOI validation is enforced at order submission
A connection may not be taken by a representative on behalf of the customer
Customer existence is determined by ID Type, ID Number and Nationality
All attributes fetched from MOI are overwritten on an existing customer record after successful MOI validation
Contact existence is determined by ID Type and ID Number
Identity attributes verified through MOI are rendered non editable
Account Type, Customer Category and Segment are mandatory for account creation
Customer Category and Segment are derived from nationality using the configured matrix
The default credit limit is set from customer segment per the parameter table below. Note: credit limit & spend limit functionlity will be updated with legacy project details.
Email Address, Language and Alternate Phone Number may be overridden by the agent
A customer account may hold multiple contacts, each carrying an assigned role
Email verification is performed through the verification service and is available to the Retail channel only
QID permits Postpaid and Prepaid. Diplomatic ID permits Postpaid and Prepaid. Passport permits Prepaid only. GCC ID permits Prepaid only
The customer must be eighteen years of age or over, calculated from Date of Birth
Each eligibility failure returns a distinct message drawn from the configured message catalogue
A customer in Blacklisted or In Collections status may not proceed
The customer may not proceed where the outstanding balance exceeds the configured threshold

A Qatari national is unrestricted. An expatriate QID holder may hold up to five mobile voice connections, all of which may be Postpaid. The third to the fifth Postpaid connection requires Credit team approval. On breach a validation message is displayed and the agent may proceed with the approval task raised
An order requiring approval is held. Submission is enabled on approval and cancellation is permitted on rejection

Credit limit enhancement does not apply to New Activation. Within the applicable journeys an agent may amend the limit up to the segment ceiling and an increase beyond the ceiling is applied by the Collections role only, through an approval ticket
The delta between the enhanced and the default credit limit is collected as a advanced payment & adjusted in next bill

jsm_initiate.title: Start the activation journey
jsm_initiate.does: Retail Agent begins a New Postpaid Activation journey for a walk-in customer from the Agent Desktop.
jsm_initiate.needs: A walk-in customer at the retail store.

jsm_auth.title: Authenticate and authorise the agent
jsm_auth.does: System checks the agent's identity and role privilege before allowing journey access.

jsm_tracking_create.title: Create a Tracking Record
jsm_tracking_create.does: System automatically creates a Tracking Record owned by the initiating agent at journey start.
jsm_tracking_create.makes: A new Tracking Record in New status.

jsm_milestone_save.title: Save journey milestone as Draft Order
jsm_milestone_save.does: On each successful stage validation the journey is saved as a Draft Order so it can be resumed later without re-entering data.

kyc_scan.title: Scan the customer's ID document
kyc_scan.does: Retail Agent scans front page, back page and optional liveliness selfie through IDWise.
kyc_scan.needs: Physical ID document and customer consent for liveliness.
kyc_scan.makes: Captured document images sent to IDWise.

kyc_moi_lookup.title: Look up the customer at MOI
kyc_moi_lookup.does: System retrieves the government MOI record using the ID number.
kyc_moi_lookup.needs: QID, Diplomatic ID or Passport Number.
kyc_moi_lookup.makes: MOI customer record or a documented not-found response.

kyc_full_match.title: Check IDWise and MOI agree
kyc_full_match.does: System compares five identity attributes between the scanned document and the MOI record; any mismatch blocks progression.

kyc_age_check.title: Verify the customer is 18+
kyc_age_check.does: System calculates age from Date of Birth and rejects under-18 customers.

cam_existing_check.title: Check whether the customer already exists
cam_existing_check.does: System matches ID Type, ID Number and Nationality against existing customer records to avoid duplicate creation.
cam_existing_check.makes: Existing customer match or new-customer path.

cam_hrn_flag.title: Derive the High Risk Nationality flag
cam_hrn_flag.does: System checks the customer's MOI nationality against the HRN list to determine if an advance payment message and payment apply.
cam_hrn_flag.needs: MOI nationality and HRN nationality list.

milestone_1.title: Milestone 1 reached
milestone_1.does: Customer contact has been created and product offer eligibility captured — the journey can be resumed from here if interrupted.
milestone_1.needs: Completed customer creation and eligibility steps.

ecc_conn_eligibility.title: Check connection type eligibility
ecc_conn_eligibility.does: System determines whether the customer's ID type permits a Postpaid connection.

ecc_expat_ceiling.title: Check the expatriate line count ceiling
ecc_expat_ceiling.does: System checks how many mobile voice connections an expatriate QID holder already has, allowing up to five with Credit approval from the third line.
ecc_expat_ceiling.makes: Proceed, or route to Credit approval, decision.

ecc_advance_deposit.title: Collect the credit limit advance payment
ecc_advance_deposit.does: System collects the difference between the default and enhanced credit limit as a refundable deposit.
ecc_advance_deposit.needs: Default and enhanced credit limit values.
ecc_advance_deposit.makes: Collected advance payment, adjusted on the next bill.

bam_account_create.title: Create or select a billing account
bam_account_create.does: Retail Agent creates a new billing account or selects an existing one for the plan being purchased.
bam_account_create.makes: A billing account ready for the cart.

bam_payment_validate.title: Validate the payment profile
bam_payment_validate.does: System validates captured card/payment details before the payment profile is activated, storing only the last 4 digits and a token.
bam_payment_validate.needs: Payment Method, Payment Type, Billing Frequency.

milestone_2.title: Milestone 2 reached
milestone_2.does: Customer bill profile has been created (Postpaid only) — journey can resume from here.
milestone_2.needs: Completed billing account and payment profile capture.

num_reserved_retrieve.title: Check for an existing number reservation
num_reserved_retrieve.does: System looks up whether the customer already has an active reserved MSISDN from any sales channel, using the QID.

num_star_eligibility.title: Filter Star Numbers by plan entitlement
num_star_eligibility.does: System only shows Star Numbers priced within the band the selected base plan entitles the customer to.
num_star_eligibility.needs: Selected base plan price and the number price eligibility matrix.

sim_type_select.title: Choose the SIM type
sim_type_select.does: Retail Agent picks Physical SIM, eSIM (printed), or Virtual eSIM for the new line.
sim_type_select.makes: SIM type carried into the cart.

cvc_prepayment_gate.title: Run the full pre-payment validation set
cvc_prepayment_gate.does: System runs every mandatory validation (customer, account, billing, number, SIM, product, eligibility, compatibility) before allowing payment.

cvc_payment_summary.title: Show the payment summary
cvc_payment_summary.does: System itemises every charge and shows the total payable before the agent confirms payment.
cvc_payment_summary.needs: All collected charges (plan, addons, premium number, HRN advance, credit advance).
cvc_payment_summary.makes: An itemised payment summary and total.

milestone_3.title: Milestone 3 reached
milestone_3.does: Cart has been checked out — journey can resume from here.
milestone_3.needs: Completed cart validation and payment summary.

caf_signature_option.title: Choose how the CAF is signed
caf_signature_option.does: Retail Agent decides between an offline paper CAF (scanned and uploaded) or a digital CAF signed on a capture device.

caf_generate.title: Generate the CAF from a template
caf_generate.does: System selects the correct CAF template by product type and service type and generates the document.
caf_generate.needs: Product type, service type, customer and cart data.

milestone_4.title: Milestone 4 reached
milestone_4.does: The CAF has been signed — journey can resume from here.

pay_request.title: Send the payment request to WinCash
pay_request.does: System sends the upfront payment request to the payment gateway and updates CRM payment status from the response.
pay_request.makes: Paid or Failed status in CRM.

pay_attempt_limit.title: Enforce the failed payment attempt limit
pay_attempt_limit.does: System counts failed payment attempts and blocks further retries once the configured maximum is reached.

ord_submit.title: Submit the order
ord_submit.does: Retail Agent submits the order once payment is confirmed as Paid.
ord_submit.makes: Order moved to the submitted state.

ord_route_fulfil.title: Route the order downstream
ord_route_fulfil.does: System submits the completed, paid order to downstream provisioning and activation systems.
ord_route_fulfil.needs: Submitted order with all line items.

ord_completion.title: Receive downstream completion
ord_completion.does: System receives a completion event from downstream provisioning/activation and updates CRM order status.
ord_completion.makes: CRM order status set to completed.

ord_tracking_resolve.title: Resolve the Tracking Record
ord_tracking_resolve.does: System sets the Tracking Record to Resolved once the order is completed, recording the order number.

not_submission.title: Notify the customer of order submission
not_submission.does: System sends a submission notification via the customer's preferred channel (email or SMS).
not_submission.needs: Order submission event and customer's preferred contact mode.

not_all_msisdn.title: Notify every MSISDN on the QID
not_all_msisdn.does: Regulatory (CRA) requirement to notify every active MSISDN registered against the customer's QID of a new activation.
not_all_msisdn.needs: All active MSISDNs under the QID.
not_all_msisdn.makes: Activation notification despatched to each MSISDN.

not_survey_trigger.title: Trigger the feedback survey
not_survey_trigger.does: Once the Tracking Record is Resolved, a feedback survey request is sent to the Customer Survey system.
not_survey_trigger.makes: Survey request despatched; Tracking Record later closed on feedback receipt.
